newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Adamjee Ins rises 4.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Adamjee Ins rises 4.50 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Adamjee Insurance Co's 10-rupee stock rose 5.00 rupees, or 4.5 percent, to 116 at the Karachi Stock Exchange on Tuesday, on hopes of higher profits and payouts for calendar 1996, dealers said.
They said Adamjee was expected to announce its results in June.
The company has paid a 15 percent interim cash dividend for 1996, compared to a 35 percent cash dividend and 25 percent bonus issues for 1995.
Some 200 Adamjee shares were traded in early business on Tuesday, one dealer said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
